claim_checks.limits: No reproduction of GAO house-construction data or figures; no claim that increased dependence worsens every deadline probability or mandates P80.

claim_checks.supported: Select response triggers and informed/executing stakeholders; monitor near thresholds; implement and track residual impact and effectiveness
claim_checks.limits: Existing SEHandbook excerpt, not advertised as the newest comprehensive NASA RM manual; authored timing/budget scenario is not NASA policy.
